name: 网文连载
description: 从一个点子开一本连载网文：设定和卖点 → 分章细纲（每章的冲突、爽点和章末钩子）→ 黄金三章正文 → 检查字数、钩子、爽点间隔和“期待感”有没有兑现。 / Start a serialized web novel from an idea: setting and hook → chapter outlines (conflict, payoff and cliffhanger for each) → the first three chapters in full → checks on length, cliffhangers, gaps between payoffs and whether the reader's expectations get paid off.

premise.description: 一句话点子，例如：外卖员捡到能看见别人好感度的眼镜 / The idea in one line, e.g. a delivery rider finds glasses that show how much people like him

genre.description: 类型，例如：都市、玄幻、仙侠、言情、悬疑、科幻 / Genre, e.g. urban, fantasy, xianxia, romance, mystery, sci-fi

chapters.description: 先写多少章细纲。前三章会写成正文 / How many chapter outlines to write first. The first three become full chapters

chapterWords.description: 每章目标字数（中文按字，英文按词）/ Target length per chapter (Chinese characters, or English words)

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 设定和卖点
stages.description: 一句话卖点、主角（目标、缺点、金手指和它的代价）、对手、世界规则，以及要让读者一直期待的 3 到 5 件事。 / The one-line hook, the protagonist (goal, flaw, edge and its cost), rivals, world rules, and 3 to 5 things the reader will keep waiting for.

stages.name: 分章细纲
stages.description: 每章一个目标、一个冲突、一个爽点和一个章末钩子，并标出推进了哪件“期待”。前三章要把冲突和金手指亮出来。 / Each chapter gets a goal, a conflict, a payoff and a closing hook, and names the expectation it moves forward. The first three chapters must show the conflict and the edge.

stages.name: 黄金三章
stages.description: 按细纲写出前三章正文。开头直接进冲突，不先交代背景；每章结尾停在钩子上。 / The first three chapters in full, following the outline. Open on the conflict, not on background, and end each chapter on its hook.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查每章字数、细纲有没有缺冲突或钩子、连续几章没有爽点、每件“期待”有没有推进、金手指有没有在前三章出现、开头是不是大段背景。 / Checks each chapter's length, outlines missing a conflict or hook, runs of chapters with no payoff, expectations never moved forward, whether the edge shows up in the first three chapters, and openings that start with a block of background.
